name: John Weems
bio: A Representative from Maryland; born in Waterloo, Calvert County, Md., in 1778; attended St. John's College, Annapolis, Md.; engaged in planting; elected as Jacksonian candidate to the Nineteenth Congress to fill the vacancy caused by the resignation of Joseph Kent; reelected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Twentieth Congress and served from February 1, 1826, to March 3, 1829; resumed agricultural pursuits; died on his plantation, ``Loch Eden,'' in Anne Arundel County, Md., January 20, 1862; interment in a private cemetery on his estate.
